kind: Analytic dye and stochastic bead teaching models

river.png.run: Periodic dye-river teaching model, in exhibit seconds
river.png.diagnostic: Dimensionless dye concentration. Three side-by-side profiles: loop f/f* in turns, receiving stream f/f* in channel lengths, independent straight river C/C* from its upstream tap to its outlet.
river.png.axes: Each strip includes both endpoints. Frames run from 0 through period_s inclusive at fps. One extra row gives constant slow-speed equilibria for the loop and independent river.
river.png.transform: Periodic 256-point Fourier advection-dispersion with local source/drain Strang splitting at 0.0125 s. Drain-weighted sluice mixing and delayed downstream advection in passing time. Exact characteristics and periodic inlet pool for the straight river. Linear resampling; lossless RGB bytes, F = pack_max (256 R + G)/65535, no gamma conversion or mipmaps.

transport.json.run: Distributed nearest-neighbour scattering on three closed orbits and two open trajectories, seed 236
transport.json.diagnostic: Equal-weight bead histories [id, segments]. Each segment is [start, end, old track, new track, starting phase]. Tracks 0–2 are trapped, 3 is blue, 4 is orange. Events identify the bead and time of a wall arrival or trapped loss during the hold.
transport.json.time: Exhibit seconds 0–36 after 900 model seconds of full-rate warm-up. Four exhibit seconds per model second. Native endpoints are retained across the displayed interval.
transport.json.geometry: Tabletop metres. The angle measures progress around an orbit. Radius labels a different orbit in phase space. Open paths follow the concentric semicircle from −π to 0 and then its tangent to the wall. Radii, straight length and clock settings are embedded in the asset.
transport.json.transform: Continuous circular motion, 0.65 exhibit seconds of smooth radial interpolation per scattering event, then a rigid tilt of the whole tabletop. During the held phase a trapped loss ends at the separatrix halfway to the blue path. Passing positions and transfers use the same frozen clock.
transport.json.rates: Per model second: inner supply 2.32 beads, each neighbouring trapped hop 0.208, outer-to-blue 0.64 on its semicircle, blue–orange exchange 1.40 on their semicircles. Full and slowed laps last 5 and 15 exhibit seconds. The passing phase advances at 0.72 radians per active exhibit second on the bend and 0.72 tabletop metres per active exhibit second on the straight.
transport.json.interpretation: Stochastic illustration of the phase split in the thesis chapter The Pseudo Orbit-Averaging Algorithm and the topology in Combined Model §3.5.1. Counts describe the bead model.
